labels.variantDefinition: Short user quotes set in the typeface itself, flowed in plain text columns with no photos, ratings or cards
labels.look: Cream field, blue-grey text in the font, five narrow columns of heartfelt reader quotes, nav bar over the bottom
labels.learn: Set testimonials in the font: for an accessibility face, the readers' own words prove the claim as they are read

labels.look: Black ruled grid of cells: huge 'i' and '1', ligatures (ff, fi, fl), æ œ, French sample sentences in a monospace; white sticky header with slider
labels.ux: Style slider in header ('Roman sélectionné'); theme toggle
labels.learn: Mix single glyphs, ligatures and full sentences in one cell grid so scale jumps keep the table lively

labels.variantDefinition: Tabs pick a rival typeface; the same word is set in this font and the rival, stacked, so differences show at a glance
labels.look: Navy, mint mono heading, segmented tabs (JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Iosevka), 'Cloudflare' in peach above the rival in pale blue
labels.ux: Switch rival via tabs; Italic toggle
labels.learn: Name the competitors and set them on the same word: an honest A/B sells better than adjectives

labels.look: Off-white, each style in its own colour (blue, red, green, yellow…) with Swiss-themed lines, pictogram glyphs inline, tiny style captions
labels.ux: Every sample is contenteditable; sticky trial/licensing bar
labels.learn: Give each style its own colour and themed copy: a long style list reads like a travel brochure, not a catalogue

labels.variantDefinition: Embedded social posts (tweets, toots) from users praising the font, in a row or grid with avatars and handles
labels.look: Dark charcoal, italic cursive heading 'What people are saying', row of embedded X/Twitter cards
labels.ux: Embedded posts link to the originals
labels.learn: For a free developer font, real public posts by known devs are the strongest proof of adoption

labels.variantDefinition: A short, informal bio of the designer with contact and social links, usually near the end of the page
labels.look: White, bold sans name heading, one paragraph of jokey bio, plain Website/Twitter links
labels.learn: A self-deprecating bio with a direct email invites conversation more than a formal CV

labels.variantDefinition: Pick a style of this font and a companion typeface; a headline-plus-body layout updates to preview the pair
labels.look: White, red pill toolbar (style dropdown, weight slider, shuffle), font chips (Area, Apoc, Oroban, Joly), 'APOC' title over body columns
labels.ux: Choose style and weight, swap pairing font, shuffle
labels.learn: Recommend pairings from your own catalogue as a live tool: it sells a second family while helping the user

labels.look: Pale mint, photo of an open school notebook with green/blue handwriting script and ruled lines, binder clips, spec caption
labels.learn: Caption the mockup with the real setting specs (12/14 pt, 45 characters per line) so it doubles as a usage guide

labels.look: White, navy-ruled licence-size cards (Mini…Testing), preview text field, full-series package row with $200 Buy Now
labels.ux: Pick licence size, type preview text, select packages, buy
labels.learn: Let buyers preview their own text right inside the cart so they confirm the choice before paying
